column1: # Proposed identifiers for elevated functions. Source of truth; consumed by
# tools/name_evidence.py, which fills the `Proposed` column of docs/names.md
# and generates docs/name-proposals.md grouped by subsystem.
# Renaming is still deferred (see docs/names.md). This file is the accumulating
# decision, not the rename itself. A bulk rename is byte-neutral -- names do not
# survive objcopy -- so `make compare` proves any eventual application of it.
#   proposed   the identifier to rename it to
#   basis      read | named | read+callee | read+family  (see docs/names.md)
#              read+callee  purpose pinned by reading an already-elevated callee
#              read+family  purpose pinned by a sibling that shares the body
#   subsystem  what part of the ROM it belongs to
#   home       where it would live under a semantic layout
#   why        one line: what in the body justifies the name
# A function whose identity the code does not establish gets an Unk<offset> or
# Unk<n> suffix and says so in `why`. Do not guess a game-facing name.

column6: why
Keeps the ROM's own name; body agrees -- scans the 15 slots at unit+0xd8 for the first equipped entry (0x200) whose info record carries the requested kind, returns the slot index or -1.
The same scan as GetEquippedItem but returns the ItemInfo record rather than the slot index, and takes the unit directly instead of looking it up.
Third member of the trio; same scan, returns the item id masked to 0x1ff. Still parked, named here so the three are renamed together.
53 calls: GiveDjinni then SetDjinni for elements 0-3 across four party slots, then CalcStats on all four. A test fixture, not reachable play.
Builds a 13x5 window at g+0x10, attaches a text layer, stores the handle at g+0x14, writes both OBJ priorities and the 0xff/0 no-selection sentinel. Returns the window.
Walks 64 actor records at iwram_3001e64 (stride 0x70), skipping empty, non-collidable (+0x59 & 1) and self, asking Func_800eba0 for radius overlap. Returns -1 on the first hit.
Twin of Actor_IsBlockedAt, identical but for returning the overlapping record or NULL.
With five or fewer turns left, rolls (luck*3 - turnsLeft*5 + strength) * 0x28f against RPGRandom() & 0xffff. The reason every TickStatusCounter rolls at all.
Counter at unit+0x132, companion signed byte 0x133, recovery strength 0x1e. Which status effect this is is not established by the body.
Counter 0x134, companion 0x135, strength 0x14. Effect identity not established by the body.
Counter 0x136, companion 0x137, strength 0x14. Effect identity not established by the body.
Counter 0x138, no companion, strength 0x1e. Effect identity not established by the body.
Counter 0x139 -- odd, so pooled rather than built with mov+lsl. Strength 0x3c.
Counter 0x13a, strength 0x46 -- the highest in the family, so the easiest effect to shake off early.
Counter 0x13b (odd, pooled), strength 0x28.
Counter 0x13c, strength 0x32.
Counter 0x13d, and the one real variant: a 3-bit count with a carry above it, brought under 8 first, decremented only when the low bits are set, failed outright above 7.
Counter 0x13e, and the only member with no recovery roll and no companion -- hence the bare push {lr} prologue.
Twelfth family member, in its own TU: counter 0x13f (odd, pooled), no companion, no recovery roll.

Draws four 2x2-tile icons across a 30-column tilemap: 32-byte source rows at .Lb3d40 + a*32, destination from .Lb413c[c], writing +0/+1/+30/+31 and advancing by four. A zero byte blanks the rest of that icon.
